raw_segments.text: Hamlet, let me see, takes the skull. Alas, poor Yorick, I knew him, Horatio, a fellow
of infinite jest, of most excellent fancy. He hath borne me on his back a thousand times,
and now how abhorred in my imagination it is. My gorge rises at it. Here hung those
lips that I have kissed I know not how oft. Where be your jibes now, your gambles, your
songs, your flashes of merriment that were wont to set the table on a roar, not one now
to mock your own grinning. Quite chop fallen.
Now get you to my lady's chamber and tell her, let her paint an inch thick, to this
favor she must come. Make her laugh at that. Prithi, Horatio, tell me one thing.
